result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visual/content anomaly is a '−100%' discount badge on a restaurant card, which reads as a data or content error (a 100% discount is almost certainly unintended). A couple of minor polish issues were also noted.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' displays a '−100%' badge, implying the entire order is free. This is almost certainly a data error or misconfigured promotion, and it undermines trust in the displayed prices.
issues.suggestion: Validate promotion values before rendering; cap or hide discount badges above a sane threshold (e.g., >90%) and fix the underlying promo data so the correct discount percentage is shown.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image sits directly on the photo without a contrasting backdrop, whereas the heart on the pizza card has a dark circular background — inconsistent treatment and potentially poor contrast on light photos.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular backdrop to all favorite icons on cards to ensure consistent styling and adequate contrast.

issues.description: Delivery fee information is duplicated on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card: a '€0 delivery' badge overlays the image while '€0 delivery' also appears in the metadata line below.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator only once (e.g., keep the badge and omit it from the metadata row) to reduce redundancy.
